body.p: Sands & McDougall's directory of Victoria and Canberra, A.C.T., 1944–1945. 2,511 pages.
State Library Victoria has digitised this directory, and you can read it online.
Listings from the 1944–1945 directory are not on the site yet, and the page range of its Carlton section is still to be noted.
The project covers the area south of Grattan Street, west of Swanston Street, east of Elizabeth Street and north of Victoria Street.
